dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL), not otherwise specified (NOS), non-germinal-center B-cell-like (non-GCB) by the Hans algorithm, with a double-expressor immunophenotype

dx_hans_not_abc.quote: TP53 mutation and gene-expression cell-of-origin status (prognostic only; not required for standard first-line treatment).

dx_not_breast_recurrence.quote: The left axillary biopsy shows no evidence of metastatic breast carcinoma (cytokeratin AE1/AE3 and GATA3 negative in the lesional cells).

stage_spleen_lymphatic.quote: There is no extralymphatic organ involvement (liver, lung, bone, adrenal, and kidney are negative), the bone marrow biopsy is negative, and there are no CNS symptoms. The spleen is a lymphatic organ, so splenic involvement is stage III (IIIS), not stage IV.

stage_b_symptoms.quote: splenic involvement, and B symptoms (fevers and night sweats)

mn_stage_iv.quote: The spleen is a lymphatic organ, so splenic involvement is stage III (IIIS), not stage IV.

mol_del_not_dh.quote: double-expressor by immunohistochemistry (MYC 45%, BCL2 70%) with high proliferation (Ki-67 80%) and focal necrosis. Interphase FISH is negative for MYC, BCL2, and BCL6 rearrangements, so this is not a double-hit or triple-hit high-grade B-cell lymphoma.

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: Interphase FISH is negative for MYC, BCL2, and BCL6 rearrangements, so this is not a double-hit or triple-hit high-grade B-cell lymphoma.

mn_da_epoch.quote: The double-expressor phenotype is associated with inferior outcomes after R-CHOP, but there is no established standard targeted escalation outside a clinical trial.

prog_cns_ipi_2.quote: CNS-IPI 2 (intermediate risk; points for stage III and elevated LDH; age under 60, ECOG 1, no more than one extranodal site, and no kidney or adrenal involvement).

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: CNS relapse risk is intermediate (CNS-IPI 2) with no high-risk extranodal site, so I do not recommend routine CNS prophylaxis.

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: I do not recommend intrathecal methotrexate or high-dose IV methotrexate prophylaxis.

tx_cardiac_aware_no_full_dox.quote: The decision is driven by the baseline LVEF 45% with reduced global longitudinal strain, prior cumulative doxorubicin 240 mg/m2, prior left breast radiotherapy, and hypertension; additional anthracycline would carry a high risk

mn_standard_dox_ignores_heart.quote: I am not using R-CHOP or pola-R-CHP because both contain doxorubicin. If cardio-oncology confirms that the cardiac risk is acceptable ... I would use R-CHOP with dexrazoxane

tx_cardio_onc_referral.quote: Before cycle 1: formal cardio-oncology consultation and confirmation of LVEF/GLS (repeat echocardiogram or cardiac MRI if there is uncertainty)

tx_cardioprotection.quote: start an ACE inhibitor or ARB and a beta-blocker for LVEF 45% if not contraindicated, optimize blood pressure

tx_anthracycline_free_curative.quote: Curative-intent anthracycline-free immunochemotherapy: R-CEOP every 21 days for 6 cycles

tx_lower_efficacy_ack.quote: with the double-expressor phenotype and the need for an anthracycline-free regimen adding uncertainty.

tx_cardiac_monitoring.quote: I will also repeat echocardiography with GLS at the end of therapy because of the baseline LVEF 45%.

mn_non_curative.quote: Curative-intent anthracycline-free immunochemotherapy: R-CEOP every 21 days for 6 cycles

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: Response will be assessed with a whole-body FDG PET-CT about 6-8 weeks after cycle 6, interpreted by Lugano/Deauville criteria (Deauville 1-3 = complete metabolic response; Deauville 4-5 = residual disease

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: Tumor lysis syndrome: allopurinol 300 mg daily (adjust for renal function) with vigorous hydration starting before cycle 1 and close monitoring of uric acid, creatinine, potassium, phosphorus, and calcium

sup_gcsf.quote: Growth factor: pegfilgrastim 6 mg SC on day 2 (or filgrastim) with each cycle.

sup_anastrozole.quote: Continue anastrozole 1 mg daily without interruption; it is not myelosuppressive and has no clinically significant interaction with R-CEOP, and stopping it would increase breast cancer recurrence risk.

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: no HBV antiviral prophylaxis is needed because HBsAg and anti-HBc are negative; anti-HBs is negative, so arrange hepatitis B vaccination

fit_curative_ecog1.quote: ECOG 1, age 59, independent, working full-time, with good social support from her husband; she is fit for full-dose curative-intent immunochemotherapy. The main limitation is cardiac reserve, not performance status or frailty. Her stated goal is cure

miss_cardiac_workup.quote: Formal cardio-oncology assessment, including a repeat echocardiogram with GLS (or cardiac MRI if there is uncertainty), to confirm LVEF 45% and to advise on anthracycline avoidance versus dexrazoxane use.
